editorial:
Imagine how far you would go to get your kid into the best school in town. You get to watch two super competitive dads turn a simple preschool application into an all-out war. It starts with small things, like who has the better resume, but quickly turns into a wild race involving fake hobbies and ridiculous bribes. The vibe is light, loud, and totally chaotic, making it the perfect choice for a Friday night when you just want to laugh at how stressed these parents are.

The acting is spot on, and the pacing never slows down, so you will not find yourself checking the clock. While some of the jokes are a bit over the top, the chemistry between the two leads makes it work. If you are a parent or just like seeing adults act like children, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the end, the two dads realize they have spent so much time fighting that they actually ignored their kids. During the final interview, their children bond instantly and tell the principal they do not want to go to the school at all. The dads apologize to each other and decide to start a local playgroup instead. They both lose the spot at the elite school, but they gain a real friendship and a better relationship with their kids.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies about parenting and rivalry.
